uin.note: Rider page publishes V04; ULIP product pages name V03.

linked_or_non_linked.value: non-linked, non-participating individual health rider; not a unit-deduction rider
linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Non-Linked, Non- Participating Individual Health rider
linked_or_non_linked.note: The policy text says a unit-deduction rider and this rider cannot be attached together, so the premium is separate.

waiver_of_premium.value: Waiver of future premium is a payout option on the insured events (regular pay, without return of balance premium). The outstanding future premium under the base plan, riders and attached benefit options at inception is waived.
waiver_of_premium.quote: The outstanding future Premium under the Base Plan, Rider/s and any attached Benefit

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.value: The waiver pays out on the insured event of the benefit option chosen: death or terminal illness (Term Booster), accidental death, ATPD or critical illness.
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: Income till survival of partner or Waiver of Premium

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.note: The rider allows cover on the life of a partner under the same plan; payor events are not described in the text read.

critical_illness.value: CritiCare Plus: lump sum on first diagnosis of any of 40 critical illnesses including cancer and cardiac conditions. Accelerated CritiCare: the same 40 illnesses, paid as an acceleration of the Term Booster amount.

accidental_death.value: Insured amount on death by accident within 180 days; double the amount for accidents in public transport, lifts, public building fires and commercial flights.
accidental_death.quote: Twice the amount of the above benefit will be payable

accidental_disability.value: Accidental total and permanent disability option within 180 days of the accident.

term_cover.value: Term Booster: Insured Amount payable on earlier of death or diagnosis of terminal illness.
term_cover.quote: The Insured Amount under this option is payable on

hospital_cash.quote: Details of benefits under each Benefit Option is as
hospital_cash.note: Options are Term Booster, Accidental Death, ATPD, CritiCare Plus and Accelerated CritiCare.

other.value: Vitality wellness programme; return of balance premium option; payout as lump sum with income, income until a partner dies, or waiver.
other.quote: Option to receive return of balance premiums on

rider_term.value: Term Booster to 82 years; accidental death and ATPD to 67 years; CritiCare options 5 years. Minimum 13 to 14 months for regular and limited pay.

premium_paying_rules.value: Regular, limited or single pay, with or without return of balance premium (not for CritiCare options).

entry_age.value: 18 to 65 years; maturity age 100 (Term Booster), 85 (accidental death, ATPD), 75 (CritiCare options)

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 25,000 per option; maximum subject to underwriting and not above the base plan death benefit.

premium_deduction.value: Separate premium, not a unit-deduction rider.
premium_deduction.quote: At no point both unit-deduction rider and this rider shall be allowed
